findingsReportedNotFixed.detail: Measured under mutant M2: once E2E-25 carries test.fail(true, ...), ANY failure in that row reads as the expected failure and Playwright prints no body and keeps no artifact for it. Under M2 the row failed at the absent rewind-preview POST (an unarmed journal), not at the gated 409, and the run still reported it as passing. The gate therefore buys green at the cost of E2E-25's own diagnostic value until the cutover lands. Two mitigations are in place and neither is mechanical: the pack header names the exact refusal the gate is for, and E2E-19 shares the same arming and the same previewCorrection helper, so an arming regression is still caught - by E2E-19, as M2 demonstrates.
findingsReportedNotFixed.recommendation: for the parent and for the cutover owner: when the gate lifts, delete the mark rather than adjusting assertions, and expect the run to go red at the moment the refusal disappears
